description: This file contains migration functions for updating configuration files and security-related command defaults in a VSCode extension, including JSON to YAML conversion and command sanitization.

methods.name: migrateSettings
methods.description: Main function to migrate old settings files to new formats and remove insecure commands.

methods.name: migrateCustomModesToYaml
methods.description: Converts custom_modes.json to YAML format, preserving the original JSON file.

methods.name: migrateDefaultCommands
methods.description: Removes insecure default commands from allowed commands list to address security vulnerabilities.
